div.div:
Three golden rules
· Node count is often capped by the POD CIDR (/20 ÷ /24 = 16 nodes), not the node subnet
· Overlap is silent until you connect networks (peering/VPN/NCC) — then it breaks catastrophically
· Never burn 10.x on managed DBs — PSA uses 100.64.0.0/10
